raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 has ingest_ts values up to 22:00, unlike every other batch, and 4996 raw rows cover only 4975 distinct txn_ids. This points to a partial re-delivery of already-loaded transactions, which silver_transactions does not deduplicate. I keep the latest delivery per txn_id (by ingest_ts, then batch_id) and apply the POSTED filter afterwards, so a later REVERSED re-delivery correctly drops the transaction.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.75,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
